items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Function names like convertNv12ToYuv420p and upsamplePlaneBilinear say what they do, but magic constants such as `((28142 * g + 16384) >> 15) + 16` have no comment linking them to FFmpeg. Stray files (`rgb24`, scratch/*.py) clutter the workspace.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Copy-paste across the code: convertNv12ToYuv420p and convertNv21ToYuv420p are near-identical, as are the 422 and 444 to 420 loops. Scalar per-format loops instead of shared @Vector helpers. Junk `rgb24` file, scratch scripts and the built .so are committed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: upsamplePlaneBilinear does `page_allocator.alloc(...) catch return`, so an allocation failure silently leaves the destination planes unwritten. It also allocates on every process call, and many unexplained fixed-point constants are hardcoded.

items.name: Geometry, stride and tail handling
items.name_zh: 几何尺寸、步长与尾部处理
items.evidence: Chroma loops use `width / 2` and `height / 2`, so odd sizes drop the last chroma column and row. Upsampling hardcodes an exact 2x ratio. The last run shows 51/58 within the bars (rgba nearest scaling at 6.8 dB), and the hidden correctness test failed.

items.name: ABI and build-target conformance
items.name_zh: ABI 与构建目标符合要求
items.evidence: Builds libswscale_candidate.so, and perf-check builds it with `zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast`. The diff doesn't show whether the x86-64-v3 target was set in build.zig (the scaffold only had a comment about it). Single-threaded, with no sign of ABI mismatch.
